disable-trigger-enable-spam.name: Confirmed you have activated all Animation Triggers?
disable-trigger-enable-spam.hint: Enable this setting to disable that pop up
disable-trigger-enable-spam.message:
[Trigger Animation Trove (PF2e)] To have this module work as expected your must enable all trigger engine triggers in the Animations folder.

To get there go to Game Settings -> Trigger Engine -> Register Triggers -> Animations -> Click the folder Icon -> Enable all Triggers underneath that folder -> click the save button at the top.

This message will repeat on startup until you confirm you have completed this setup in this module's settings under Game Settings

force-refresh-menu.label: Enable All Animations
force-refresh-menu.hint: Asks the user to enable all animations again if they for whatever reason dismissed some dialog or want to force them to be enabled again

enable.name: Enable Automatic Token Image for Forms
enable.hint: When enabled, this module will automatically cause certain effects that would change the appearance of a token such as Animal Form, to actually change the art Token Image Rule Elements

do-pan-effects.name: Enable Panning Effects
do-pan-effects.hint: When this is disabled, any animations included with Trove will not run the panning portion of their effects

triggers.description: New triggers were added, enable these to add the new triggers
